name: Guinea-Bissau
description: Guinea-Bissau from the Kaabu kingdom and Portuguese Guinea to the war of liberation, independence in 1973 and many coups.

checkpoints.name: Kaabu and Portugal
checkpoints.note: Portuguese ships came in 1446. Kaabu ruled much of the land until 1867, and Portugal made it a colony.

checkpoints.name: Liberation
checkpoints.note: Cabral's party fought Portugal from 1963 and declared independence in 1973.

checkpoints.name: Independent Guinea-Bissau
checkpoints.note: Portugal recognised independence in 1974. Coups and a civil war followed, and no elected president served a full term until 2019.
